title: URL Slug Generator
description: Generate clean, SEO-friendly URL slugs from any text. Remove special characters and optimize your website URLs for better search engine indexing and
placeholder: e.g. How to Buy Bitcoin in 2025!
bestPracticesItem1: Keep slugs short — under 60 characters where possible.
bestPracticesItem2: Use hyphens (-) to separate words, never underscores.
bestPracticesItem3: Include your primary keyword, drop stop words like "the" or "and".
bestPracticesItem4: Always use lowercase letters for consistency.
